name: pixel-liquid-bg
title: Pixel Liquid Background
description: A near-black backdrop where a pink fluid simulation is stirred by the pointer and then rendered as large dithered blocks with faint grain, so the motion reads as low-resolution liquid.
use: A hero or page background should feel alive and tactile, and hot pink liquid suits a bold dark theme.
avoid: It is a WebGL sim running every frame, the palettes are fixed pink, and it needs a container with real height.
a11y: The constant motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion and the canvas offers no keyboard or screen-reader path. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with blooms of hot pink and magenta, each visibly built from square blocks with soft dithered edges. A light noise grain covers the surface and the shapes fade out into the surrounding darkness.
behaves: The fluid never rests: the pointer pushes and folds it, and when the pointer is idle an auto-driver keeps it wandering. Blobs stretch, curl and dissolve while the block grid stays fixed over them.
customise: Set darkPalette and lightPalette colour stops, pixelSize for the block grid, resolution, mouseForce and cursorSize, and turn off the idle driver with autoDemo. Children render above the canvas.
weight: heavy: A full WebGL fluid sim with eight pressure iterations and a fragment pass every frame.
